messages:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy to sandbox-sim-04
samir.patel: thanks — which image/tag and migration are we running?
deploy-bot: Image: registry.redwood.io/inference:release-2026-11-9a3b7f\nTag: release-2026-11-9a3b7f\nCommit: 9a3b7f4c\nMigration: add-kv-prefix-index (db schema v12 -> v13)
deploy-bot: CI: smoke + e2e passed on main branch (pipeline #4821). rolling out canary 5% (2 pods) now. rollout URL: https://k8s-console/redwood/sbx/sandbox-sim-04/rollouts/9a3b7f
jen_liu: putting an ops note — this migration touches prefix lookups, watch latency dashboards during canary
lia: seeing a small mem uptick on sbx-cluster-2 at 90s mark, +12% over baseline. not huge but worth watching :eyes:
ops-oncall: I’ll keep an eye on traces and open a quick perf capture if it goes >20% for 3m
samir.patel: if latency p50 > 120ms or mem >20% we should pause and consider pin to release-2026-11-8827ab (previous stable)
deploy-bot: Canary at 5% completed: 2/2 pods ready. Healthchecks: OK. Perf snapshot URL: https://perf.redwood/shot/2418001234
lia: perf snapshot looks ok for image 1 request sample, but a few tail latencies at p99 +80ms vs baseline. rolling more cautiously.
jen_liu: hold increase to 25% until we evaluate a few more requests. can you pause the rollout? @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 5% on user request by jen_liu. No further pods scheduled.
samir.patel: copying metrics from the perf snapshot:\n```
p50: 48ms\np95: 110ms\np99: 340ms\nmem_rss: 1.1Gi -> 1.24Gi (+12%)
```
lia: p99 spike looks correlated with a specific prefix pattern in requests — I'll push a quick canary log filter in the next 5m and re-run a sample
ops-oncall: if you decide to rollback, use this command:\n`kubectl set image deployment/inference-sbx inference=registry.redwood.io/inference:release-2026-11-8827ab -n sandbox`\nI’ll be standing by to approve the change window seal
jen_liu: after discussing with infra — prefer rollback for now to avoid any noisy tails during QA. samir, you good with rollback?
samir.patel: agree. Rollback to release-2026-11-8827ab. postmortem note: investigate kv-prefix-index hot paths. tagging: rollback-2418001234
deploy-bot: Starting rollback: reverting image to release-2026-11-8827ab. executing 2-step scale and image set. Command output:\n```
$ kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-sbx -n sandbox\nWaiting for rollout to finish: 1 old replica(s) remain to be terminated...\ndeployment "inference-sbx" successfully rolled out
```
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Current image: release-2026-11-8827ab. Canary status: 5% (previous stable). Healthchecks: OK. :white_check_mark:
lia: confirming metrics trending back toward baseline, mem down to +3% over baseline after 4m
jen_liu: thanks everyone. I’ll add rollout notes to the release ticket and mark this deploy as aborted/rolled back. follow-up: load test the prefix lookup path and add a guarding feature flag for the migration.
samir.patel: opening a small follow-up ticket: infra/kv-prefix-hotpath (assign: lia). tagging release with note: "sandbox rollback after p99 tails; revert to stable image; root cause investigation pending"
deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot. If you need a replay, run `/deploy replay 2418001234`
